text.text_excerpt: This place is brand new but came highly recommended by a local - we ordered 5 steak sandwiches & 5 pretzels to go on a Saturday right after opening time. All of the sandwiches were perfectly made to order in spite of each one ordered with different combinations of cheese and toppings. They use soft poboy bread, the meat has lots of flavor, and the toppings are fresh. We were told to go for the homemade cheese sauce (cheese whiz) but in place to provolone and were not disappointed at all by that decision. There are tables outside and inside if you want to eat there. Drink options are limited right now but we were told that they are hoping to have a fountain drink machine soon. The staff is...
Great cheesesteaks! Friendly service and they do free delivery to your bar stool! I like all topping options too, delivery was very fast. Definitely gonna be eating here a lot.

Wow! As someone who spent some time in the north and has had the real deal cheesesteaks, I was so happy to have a chance to try out cheesesteaks made in New Orleans! The owners are from Pittsburgh and love to bring their love of cheesesteaks to us southerners to enjoy. Thank goodness they did, because they are amazing! I had the original cheesesteak extra provolone with a HOMEMADE pretzel. Everything about this cheesesteak was glorious! I mean I felt like I was transported back to Philly in 2008.
